transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Um... I guess I'm here because I've just been having this constant... restless feeling. It's like I'm wound too tight, maybe. 

I just can't seem to fully settle. Even when I'm supposed to be calmly sitting through a planning meeting for work, or... or even doing things at home, like painting or yoga. I just don't settle.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energized or high, beyond your normal self?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I've ever felt... high, or anything like that. Just the restlessness I mentioned.
Did this restless feeling start after a specific stressful event or major change in your life?
Um... no. I don't think so. I can't really think of any... specific event or anything like that. It's just sort of always... been there, I guess.
Did you also feel this same kind of restlessness when you were a child?

Yes... I suppose so. I remember, um, in elementary school... my parents would get notes sent home. Because I couldn't seem to just stay in my seat. And I guess I would talk over the other kids... or blurt out answers before the teacher was even done asking. So... yes.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on tasks, even when you want to pay attention?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean, I usually get my work done fine. I haven't really noticed any... problems with paying attention, no.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I do. I mean, I worry about normal things sometimes, I guess, but... no, not for no reason.
Do you often interrupt people before they’ve finished speaking?

I suppose I do... sometimes. Um, when I'm negotiating with vendors for work, or... I do some STEM mentoring... I guess I have a habit of jumping in with an answer before they're done asking the question. And then... well, sometimes I realize I missed an important detail because I didn't wait. So, yes.
